invented.quote: The 9 new clinics made up for that revenue, which is why monthly revenue stayed flat instead of falling.
invented.why: The brief does not state the cause of the flat revenue or whether the revenue from the 9 new clinics specifically offset the loss of the 4 lost clinics (as as much or all of the offset could have come from existing customer expansion).

invented.quote: a basic scheduler that comes free with their records system
invented.why: The brief only says the scheduler is built into their electronic records system, not that it is basic or comes free.

invented.quote: It also works no matter which scheduler a clinic uses.
invented.why: The brief only says the company will sell the reminder feature on its own, not that it works with any scheduler a clinic uses.

invented.quote: This lets us sell to clinics that are committed to their records system's scheduler, including groups like the chain we just lost, without having to replace that scheduler.
invented.why: The brief does not state that the standalone reminder feature can integrate with or be sold to clinics using their records system's scheduler without replacing it.
